pages.text: Transporting liquid matter through ethereal space adheres to harmonic fluid resonance. By focusing on a $(l:create:fluid_pipe)Create Pipe$(), the caster binds it to a designated dimensional channel.$(br2)Nodes sharing the same channel ID synchronize fluid contents instantaneously.
Transmutes the pipe into a $(l:arcane_bridge:phase_fluid_tx)Phase Source (TX)$(). Any fluid pumped into this node is fed into the ether channel.
Transmutes the pipe into a $(l:arcane_bridge:phase_fluid_rx)Phase Receiver (RX)$(). Allows external pumps to draw fluid from the ether channel.
